items.title: Goldman's Bell: Stay Overweight Equities, Add Bonds as Buffer
items.title_ko: Goldman's Bell: Stay Overweight Equities, Add Bonds as Buffer
items.summary_ko: Sharon Bell, senior European equity strategist at Goldman Sachs, discusses the outlook for the AI trade after the rally in stocks that followed Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia. "We may stay overweight equities, but you want to buffer that with bonds," Bell tells Bloomberg Television.

items.title: Fujitsu CTO on AI Focus & Outlook
items.title_ko: Fujitsu CTO on AI Focus & Outlook
items.summary_ko: Vivek Mahajan, CTO of Fujitsu, discusses the global rollout of the company's Monaka server and its strategy to build infrastructure for sovereign AI. He says Fujitsu is targeting sectors where security is critical, including defense, finance, government and manufacturing, as demand for trusted AI infrastructure grows.
